identity_note: The nine dimensions are the immutable prepared-environment identity of spec §6 W4. The artifact identity string is derived from ALL nine at runtime by scripts/ci/prepared-env-report.rkt --identity-emit (schema prepared-env-identity@1): a difference in ANY dimension yields a different artifact identity, so a distinct Racket/platform/policy environment can never cross-reuse an artifact by name. The env-profile below records the four coarse profile axes (os/arch/racket-version/policy); the remaining dimensions are pinned at runtime per job by the identity manifest compare in .github/actions/setup-racket (repository, git-sha and lock digest are additionally enforced by the W3 restore verify). The artifact-identity tokens below NAME identity classes; the runtime manifests pin the exact bytes.

producer.policy_note: 'default' = the environment-policy class that shapes the produced bytes (locked user package store schema racket-addon-v2, explicit PLTADDONDIR, precompile recipe 'raco setup --no-docs --jobs 4 --pkgs q fmt', BUG-0065 no-trusted-workspace-bytecode invariant). Test-execution flags of a consumer payload (e.g. STRICT_TEST_RUNNER) do not change the produced environment and are not part of the identity; the strict SECURITY queue is nevertheless kept on a reserved separate identity class below (spec gate: no strict-security consumer receives a weaker prepared environment).
producer.retention: upload-artifact retention-days 1, same-run consumption only (actions/download-artifact scoping)
